description: Generate the privacy policy, support page and (for DE/AT) Impressum as Markdown from shelfready.yaml. write: false returns the pages without writing files. swiftui writes a SwiftUI LegalView with the Impressum for the in-app requirement. The pages are drafts, not legal advice.

frontMatter.description: Front matter for static site generators. Default jekyll.

out.description: Output folder inside the repo. Default shelfready/pages.

path.description: App repository folder. Default: the server's working directory.

swiftui.description: Also write LegalView.swift to this path inside the repo.

write.description: false to only return the pages. Default true.

name: pages
title: Generate legal pages
